Sensitive API names and the payload are not present as plaintext strings; payload is double-encrypted (XOR then RC4) in .data to defeat static signature/YARA scanning
Injection target path is assembled from 64-bit immediate constants on the stack instead of being stored as a contiguous string
Runtime redirection of execution via SetThreadContext RCX instead of CreateRemoteThread/WriteProcessMemory-on-entrypoint, avoiding the most commonly hooked injection API
Benign-looking import set (only KERNEL32 + msvcrt, no ntdll/ws2_32) reduces static suspicion
